messages:
incident-bot: Pager -> P1 detected: inference-gateway reporting elevated tokenization anomalies for model rwood-model-v2. symptom: long runs of repeated special tokens and truncated outputs. alerted to oncall-runtime.

aj: oncall-runtime taking this. seeing token OOV spikes in canary and prod. metrics dashboard -> https://internal.redwood/inference/metrics spikes at 7132468805.

deploy-bot: autopromote executed: promote --artifact abc123 --strategy autopromote at 2024-11-03T18:00:00Z (7132468800). no manual approval recorded.

kevin: quick check of canary logs: tokenizer WARN: vocab mismatch (vocab_version: 2024-10-30) vs cluster baseline (2024-09-12).

maria: CS reporting customers see outputs like "▁▁▁▁..." and many truncated generations. several enterprise tickets opened.

sophie: propose immediate traffic pin to previous artifact sha def456. can we force route back?

aj: initiating hot rollback routing now. command: rwctl route set inference-gateway --model rwood-model-v2 --target-sha def456 --reason "hot rollback: tokenizer mismatch"

deploy-bot: routing change applied; propagation ~30s.

kevin: flag check: auto_promote_weights was ENABLED. we should flip it off and audit promote job.

sophie: toggling LaunchDarkly flag: auto_promote_weights -> false (audit id ld-20241103-775).

maria: CS: enterprise traffic error rate falling but we still see residual bad responses from cached kube pods and CDN. open tickets: 12, enterprise escalations: 2.

aj: evicting caches + restarting serving pods in canary to clear KV caches: kubectl rollout restart deploy/serving-canary -n inference

kevin: preliminary RCA: autopromote pipeline promoted artifact abc123 which included new weights but tokenizer metadata mismatched; promote job did not validate tokenizer checksum. abc123 missing tokenizer_checksum metadata.

maria: impact summary: peak affected ~0.8% of inference requests during window; customers impacted notified (accounts A,B).

sophie: I ran a small golden prompt test comparing def456 vs abc123: prompt: "Translate: Hello" -> abc123 yields garbage token sequences; def456 normal. Immediate fix: block autopromote behavior when tokenizer checksum != cluster baseline.

aj: timeline notes: autopromote 7132468800; anomaly observed 7132468805; detection/pager 7132468901; rollback routing 7132468920; flag flip 7132468940; CDN purge kicked 7132469000.

kevin: action items (short): 1) keep autopromote disabled 2) add tokenizer_checksum required field in artifact metadata + promote validation 3) add lightweight canary E2E: run 10 golden prompts and check token diffs before swap 4) alert on tokenizer mismatch during promote 5) clear caches after any promote.

maria: ops: creating incident tracker INC-2024-234 assign aj as owner. CS to send templated outreach to impacted customers.

aj: ack. I will own the postmortem and set a 2pm UTC follow-up meeting. I will add remediation tasks to the incident ticket.

deploy-bot: archived note: promotion abc123 flagged and traffic reverted; artifacts tagged hot-rollback-7132468901.

incident-bot: severity reduced to P2. continue observation for 2 hours. leave thread open for updates.

sophie: starting draft PR for promote validation checks and small canary harness.

kevin: postmortem scope: require tokenizer_checksum:string and vocab_version:string in artifact schema; add pre-promote validation step.

maria: ops reminder: purge CDN keys for inference responses for the incident window. cdnctl purge --prefix /inference/responses (requested).

aj: final check at 7132470300: error rates back to baseline, closing active pager. postmortem owner: aj.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2024-234 closed (automated). reopen if further regressions observed.
